name: Tania
source:
19th century. Girl Tania is born in a well-off family. But at the age of 6 a pillar of light pierced the girl making her faint and leaving a black mole on her chest. Now when the little girl grew into a young lady she starts to see strange dreams and to have strange desires...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
19世纪，女孩塔妮娅出生在一个富裕家庭。六岁那年，一道光柱贯穿她的身体，使她当场昏厥，胸前还留下了一颗黑痣。如今，小女孩已经长成少女，却开始做起奇怪的梦，也产生了种种异常欲望……

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
